entry.summary: Let $phi.alt\,psi$ be simple functions in $L^(+)\(mu\)$, 有: - homogeneity: 对于任意非负 $c$, 有 $integral c phi.alt = c integral phi.alt$ - linearity: $integral\(phi.alt + psi\)= integral phi.alt + integral psi$ - monotonicity: $phi.alt lt.eq psi arrow.r.double.long integral phi.alt lt.eq integral psi$ - induced measure: $A mapsto integral_A phi.alt d mu$ 是一个 $cal(M)$ 上的 measure.

entry.summary: 对非负 simple functions $phi.alt = sum_(j = 1)^n a_j chi_(E_j) in L^(+)\(mu\)$, 我们定义 the integral of $phi.alt$ on $A in cal(M)$ with respect to $mu$ by: $ integral_A phi.alt d mu := integral phi.alt chi_A d mu $ 对于 general 的 $f in L^(+)\(mu\)$, 我们也从而定义: $ integral_A f d mu := sup { integral_A phi.alt d mu divides 0 lt.eq phi.alt lt.eq f\,phi.alt upright(" simple") } $

entry.summary: 给定一个 measure space $\(X\,cal(M)\,mu\)$ 我们定义: $ L^(+)\(mu\):= { bold("measurable functions ") f : X arrow.r\[0\,oo\]} $ 对于所有的 simple functions $phi.alt = sum_(j = 1)^n a_j chi_(E_j) in L^(+)\(mu\)$, 即所有非负的 simple functions, 我们定义 the integral of $phi.alt$ with respect to $mu$ by: $ integral phi.alt d mu \(= integral_X phi.alt d mu\):= sum_(i = 1)^n a_j mu\(E_j\) $ 对于任意的 $f in L^(+)\(mu\)$, 我们定义 the integral of $f$ with respect to $mu$ by: $ integral f d mu \(= integral_X f d mu\):= sup { integral phi.alt d mu divides 0 lt.eq phi.alt lt.eq f\,phi.alt upright(" simple") } $

text: 给定一个 measure space $\(X\,cal(M)\,mu\)$ 我们定义: $ L^(+)\(mu\):= { bold("measurable functions ") f : X arrow.r\[0\,oo\]} $ 对于所有的 simple functions $phi.alt = sum_(j = 1)^n a_j chi_(E_j) in L^(+)\(mu\)$, 即所有非负的 simple functions, 我们定义 the integral of $phi.alt$ with respect to $mu$ by: $ integral phi.alt d mu \(= integral_X phi.alt d mu\):= sum_(i = 1)^n a_j mu\(E_j\) $ 对于任意的 $f in L^(+)\(mu\)$, 我们定义 the integral of $f$ with respect to $mu$ by: $ integral f d mu \(= integral_X f d mu\):= sup { integral phi.alt d mu divides 0 lt.eq phi.alt lt.eq f\,phi.alt upright(" simple") } $
